Business Rule: [INFERRED] Customer enters 10-digit Indian phone number (+91 optional). Backend generates cryptographically secure 6-digit numeric OTP, saves hash to 'otps' table with 5-minute expiry, and dispatches via Twilio SMS (or mock logger in dev/test). Rate-limited to prevent SMS bombing.

Feature Name: Customer Phone OTP Verification & JWT Issuance
Business Rule: [DOCUMENTED] Validates submitted 6-digit OTP against unexpired, unused record in 'otps'. Marks OTP as used. If user does not exist, registers new customer. Generates HMAC-SHA256 signed JWT bearer token containing user UUID, email/phone, and ROLE_CUSTOMER.

Feature Name: Google OAuth2 Single Sign-On & Account Linking
Business Rule: [DOCUMENTED] Receives Google ID Token from client. Verifies token signature and audience against Google OAuth2 client ID. Extracts email, name, avatar. Links Google user ID to customer_identities. Issues Sporekart JWT.
External Integration: Google Identity API (OAuth2 ID Token Verification)

Business Rule: [INFERRED] When a Google OAuth account shares a phone number with an existing phone-authenticated account, system raises DuplicateIdentityConflictException. Requires customer confirmation to merge identities.
[DOCUMENTED] Extracts authenticated user UUID from Bearer JWT. Loads user profile, verified status, roles, and default address. If token missing or expired, returns 401.
[DOCUMENTED] Admin operator enters registered email or phone. Backend verifies that user exists and possesses 'ROLE_ADMIN'. Rejects non-admin users immediately with 403. Dispatches admin OTP.

Feature Name: Admin OTP Verification & Privileged JWT Issuance
Business Rule: [DOCUMENTED] Validates admin OTP. Issues privileged JWT containing 'ROLE_ADMIN' claim. Records successful admin login event in admin_audit_logs with client IP and user agent.

[INFERRED] All anonymous browsing and cart actions carry an 'X-Session-ID' header ('sess_' + UUID). Generated on client in localStorage if missing. Backend uses this session ID to isolate guest carts, orders, and addresses prior to authentication.
[DOCUMENTED] Customers can view and update their profile details including Full Name, GSTIN (validated against 15-character Indian GST format), Farm Size in sq ft, and mushroom cultivation interests.

Feature Name: Customer Multi-Address Management with Alternate Phone
Business Rule: [DOCUMENTED] Customers can maintain multiple shipping addresses. Exactly one address can be set as default. Supports 6-digit Indian PIN code validation, mandatory recipient name, 10-digit phone, and optional alternate delivery phone (Migration V29).

[INFERRED] When a customer successfully completes a verified masterclass (e.g. Spawn Production), TrainingCapabilityEventListener listens to CourseCompletedEvent and automatically sets 'has_training_capability = TRUE' and 'training_capability_granted_at = NOW()'. Unlocks wholesale commercial spawn ordering.
[DOCUMENTED] Administrators can search customer directory by name, email, phone, or GSTIN, inspect customer order/training history, and manually grant commercial capabilities.
[DOCUMENTED] Maintains hierarchical categories (e.g. Oyster Spawn, Button Spawn, Substrates, Lab Equipment, Sterilization Tools). Categories have unique URL-friendly slugs and display order.

[DOCUMENTED] Provides paginated catalog of active products. Supports filtering by product type (SPAWN, KIT, EQUIPMENT, CHEMICAL), category slug, price range, and sort order (price asc/desc, popularity, newest).
[DOCUMENTED] Resolves product by slug. Includes high-res gallery images, all packaging variants (e.g. 500g, 1kg, 5kg commercial sack), SKU, GST tax percentage, stock status badge, and agronomy specs.
[INFERRED] Aggregates products based on recent sales volume and customer review ratings to populate 'Grower Favorites' and 'Best Sellers' carousels on Homepage.
[DOCUMENTED] Accepts query string 'q'. Performs case-insensitive matching across Products (title, description), Training Courses (title, syllabus), Blog Posts (title, tags), and Agronomy Guides.

[DOCUMENTED] Allows administrators to attach technical mycology specifications to products: optimal temperature range (e.g. 24-28C), humidity requirement (85-90%), incubation period (18-21 days), substrate compatibility (Paddy straw, wheat straw, sawdust), and biological efficiency yield (80-120%).
[INFERRED] Administrators can attach limited-time offer badges (e.g. 'Introductory 15% Off', 'Buy 5 Get 1 Free') to specific products with start and end dates.
[DOCUMENTED] Full administrative lifecycle for catalog: Create product, edit pricing, toggle active status, add SKU variants, reorder media images, and publish drafts.
[DOCUMENTED] Fetches available_quantity and reserved_quantity from inventory_records. Product variant card displays 'In Stock', 'Only X Left', or 'Out of Stock'.

[DOCUMENTED] Locks inventory_records row using PESSIMISTIC_WRITE (SELECT FOR UPDATE). Decrements available_quantity and increments reserved_quantity atomically. Throws IllegalStateException if insufficient stock.
[DOCUMENTED] When order transitions to PAID via Razorpay verification or webhook, reserved_quantity is permanently decremented. Confirms permanent sale.

[DOCUMENTED] When an unpaid or paid order is cancelled before shipping, inventoryService.releaseCancelledOrder restores available_quantity and decrements reserved (or total) stock. Emits RESTOCK audit event.
[DOCUMENTED] Every change to stock (RESERVE, CONFIRM, CANCEL_RELEASE, REPLENISH, DAMAGE_ADJUSTMENT) writes an immutable record to inventory_audit_events with timestamp, delta, and actor.
[DOCUMENTED] Warehouse operators can replenish stock for a variant by submitting positive quantity and restock reason. Adds to available_quantity atomically.
[DOCUMENTED] Creates or retrieves active cart for anonymous guest via X-Session-ID header. Persists items across page refreshes.

Feature Name: Cart Item Mutations (Add, Update, Remove, Clear)
Business Rule: [DOCUMENTED] Supports adding variants, updating quantity, removing items, and clearing cart. Verifies available stock before adding or incrementing.

[DOCUMENTED] When guest logs in, POST /cart/merge transfers all guest cart items into customer's persistent user cart, combining quantities for identical variants up to available stock. Marks guest cart CONVERTED.

Feature Name: Single Active Cart Partial Unique Constraint
Business Rule: [INFERRED] Enforces that a user can have at most one cart with status='ACTIVE' at any time via Flyway V37 partial index 'uq_carts_user_active'. Prevents duplicate cart race conditions.
[DOCUMENTED] Validates all cart items before proceeding to checkout: checks if variants are still active, prices have changed, or items are out of stock. Flags discrepancies.

[DOCUMENTED] Validates promo code against promotions table: verifies active status, start/end dates, audience (CUSTOMER vs TRAINEE), min order value, max usage limits, and user single-use constraints.
[DOCUMENTED] Computes exact discount amount. If percentage, caps at max_discount_inr if specified. Adds GST calculation on discounted taxable value. Sets shipping_fee_inr.
[DOCUMENTED] Upon successful order placement or training booking, records promo code usage in promotion_usages and increments current_usage_count in promotions atomically.
[DOCUMENTED] Administrators can create coupons, configure target audiences (CUSTOMER, TRAINEE, BATCH_SPECIFIC), set start/end dates, toggle active status, and view redemption counts.

Feature Name: Order Creation from Cart with Idempotency
Business Rule: [DOCUMENTED] Converts active cart to order in PENDING_PAYMENT status. Locks and reserves inventory. Deduplicates concurrent requests using 'Idempotency-Key' header. Clears cart upon order creation.
Database Tables: orders, order_items, order_events, carts, cart_items, inventory_records

Business Rule: [DOCUMENTED] Freezes complete shipping address details (recipient name, phone, alternate phone, line1, line2, city, state, pincode) as an immutable JSON string in orders.shipping_address_json at order placement time.
[DOCUMENTED] Generates human-readable, non-sequential order number matching format 'SK-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXX' using SecureRandom. Validates uniqueness against database with up to 10 retry attempts.
[DOCUMENTED] Fetches chronological list of past orders for authenticated user (or guest session). Excludes internal draft states.
[DOCUMENTED] Validates that requested order belongs to authenticated userId or active guest sessionId. Unauthorized callers receive HTTP 403 Forbidden.

[DOCUMENTED] Generates dynamic binary PDF document containing Sporekart agritech branding, buyer GSTIN, SAC/HSN codes (0602 for mushroom spawn), taxable value, CGST (2.5%), SGST (2.5%) or IGST (5%), total amount in INR, and digital seal.

[DOCUMENTED] Customers can cancel orders prior to SHIPPED or DELIVERED status. Automatically releases reserved stock back to available inventory. Cancels logistics pickup if scheduled. Transitions order to CANCELLED (if unpaid) or REFUNDED (if paid).

[DOCUMENTED] When a paid order is cancelled, system calculates total paid amount (subtotal + tax + shipping - discount) and executes immediate credit to customer's Sporekart Wallet. Emits double-entry ledger record.

Feature Name: Admin Order Control Plane & Terminal Enforcement
Business Rule: [DOCUMENTED] Administrators can view all orders, filter by status, update status (CONFIRMED, PROCESSING, SHIPPED, DELIVERED). Rejects modifying terminal states (CANCELLED, REFUNDED). Prohibits manual admin jump from SHIPPED to DELIVERED (must be courier webhook driven).

[DOCUMENTED] Generates PDF warehouse packing slip containing order number, picker checklist, item SKU, variant description, quantity, warehouse bin location, and shipping address for warehouse dispatch staff.

Feature Name: Razorpay Payment Initiation for E-Commerce Orders
Business Rule: [DOCUMENTED] Generates Razorpay order via RazorpayClient.orders.create with exact order total in paise (INR * 100). Records payment entity in INITIATED status with razorpay_order_id. Supports mock fallback mode in dev.

Feature Name: Razorpay Payment Initiation for Training Enrollments
Business Rule: [DOCUMENTED] Generates Razorpay payment intent specifically for classroom masterclass seat enrollment fees.

[DOCUMENTED] Validates cryptographic HMAC-SHA256 signature calculated over (razorpay_order_id + '|' + razorpay_payment_id) using razorpay_key_secret. If valid, marks payment CAPTURED, transitions order to PAID, and confirms reserved inventory.

[DOCUMENTED] Asynchronously receives server-to-server webhook callbacks from Razorpay. Validates X-Razorpay-Signature header against raw request body using razorpay_webhook_secret. Updates payment and order status independently of client browser.

[DOCUMENTED] Prevents double-processing of duplicate webhook dispatches by storing event_id in payment_events table with unique constraint. Catches DataIntegrityViolationException and returns HTTP 200 idempotent ignore.

Feature Name: Automated Training Seat Confirmation via Webhook
Business Rule: [DOCUMENTED] When webhook receives payment.captured for a training enrollment payment, parses enrollment ID from payment events, transitions enrollment from PENDING_PAYMENT to CONFIRMED, and increments batch enrolled_count.
[DOCUMENTED] Ingests refund.processed webhook from Razorpay. Updates payment status to REFUNDED, records refund_id and amount, and publishes payment refunded audit event.
[DOCUMENTED] Captures payment.failed gateway webhooks or client failure callbacks. Records failure error code, error description, and reason in payment_events. Sets payment status to FAILED.
[DOCUMENTED] Every registered customer possesses a dedicated digital wallet. On first access, auto-provisions wallet with ₹0.00 balances (available, pending, withdrawable). Tracks currency ('INR').

Feature Name: Pessimistic Row Locking on Wallet Updates
Business Rule: [DOCUMENTED] All wallet balance modifications (credit, debit, withdrawal, topup) acquire a pessimistic write lock (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE via WalletRepository.findByUserIdWithLock). Prevents double-spend concurrency race conditions.
[DOCUMENTED] Customer specifies topup amount. Validates amount > 0 and <= ₹100,000. Creates Razorpay payment order and persists WalletTopupIntent in PENDING status.

[DOCUMENTED] Verifies cryptographic signature for wallet topup. Checks that intent is in PENDING status. Credits available_balance and withdrawable_balance. Marks intent COMPLETED. Writes CREDIT ledger entry.

Feature Name: Direct Checkout Payment via Wallet Balance
Business Rule: [DOCUMENTED] Allows customer to pay for an order directly using wallet funds. Acquires pessimistic lock, verifies available_balance >= order total, debits wallet, writes DEBIT ledger entry, transitions order to PAID, and confirms inventory.

[DOCUMENTED] Enforces that wallet balances never drop below zero via both application check (availableBalance.compareTo(amount) >= 0) and database level CHECK constraint 'chk_wallets_balance_non_negative' (Migration V32).

Feature Name: Order Cancellation Refund Credit to Wallet
Business Rule: [DOCUMENTED] When a paid order is cancelled by customer or admin, credits exact paid total to customer's wallet. Sets transaction type CREDIT, source ORDER, and records cancellation reason.

[DOCUMENTED] Customers can request bank withdrawal of their withdrawable_balance. Submits bank account number, IFSC code, account holder name. Moves requested amount from available_balance to pending_balance.
[DOCUMENTED] Administrator reviews bank details and approves payout. Marks withdrawal APPROVED. Decrements pending_balance. Writes WITHDRAWAL transaction to audit ledger.
[DOCUMENTED] If customer bank details are invalid, admin rejects withdrawal with mandatory reason. Decrements pending_balance and returns funds back to available_balance immediately.

Feature Name: Admin Manual Credit/Debit Adjustment with Audit Trail
Business Rule: [DOCUMENTED] Administrator can perform manual discretionary adjustments to customer wallets for promotional rewards, customer support appeasements, or dispute corrections. Mandatory reason and audit logging.
[DOCUMENTED] Validates 6-digit Indian postal code. Determines courier coverage (Blue Dart, Delhivery, Express) and estimated delivery transit days (2-5 business days).
External Integration: Shiprocket Serviceability API / local courier lookup

Business Rule: [DOCUMENTED] Dispatches paid order to Shiprocket logistics platform via adhoc order creation. Sends pickup location ('Primary' in Pune, PIN 411001), package dimensions (length, breadth, height in cm, weight in kg), and items. Creates shipment entity.
[DOCUMENTED] Assigns Air Waybill (AWB) code from carrier (Blue Dart Express, Delhivery). Generates carrier tracking URL ('https://track.shiprocket.in/{awb}') and updates order tracking info.
[DOCUMENTED] Fetches real-time milestone checkpoints (Picked Up, In Transit, Reached Hub, Out for Delivery, Delivered) from Shiprocket tracking API and syncs with shipment_trackings table.

Feature Name: Shiprocket Tracking Webhook Ingestion & Status Sync
Business Rule: [DOCUMENTED] Ingests carrier webhook callbacks. Validates webhook token. Maps courier statuses: 'DELIVERED' transitions order to DELIVERED, sets delivered_at timestamp, publishes OrderDeliveredEvent, and unlocks customer review invitation.

Feature Name: Courier Pickup Cancellation prior to Transit
Business Rule: [DOCUMENTED] Cancels scheduled courier pickup if order is cancelled before courier arrives at facility. Dispatches cancellation request to carrier API and updates shipment status to CANCELLED.

[INFERRED] Testing utility endpoint permitting QA and developers to simulate courier transit events (PICKED_UP, IN_TRANSIT, OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, DELIVERED) with custom location and activity strings in non-production environments.

[DOCUMENTED] Catalogs masterclass training programs across categories (Mushroom Cultivation, Spawn Production Lab Setup, Commercial Farm Automation). Each course features syllabus, duration in days, and fee in INR.
[DOCUMENTED] Displays detailed curriculum for a course by slug: daily module timetable, practical lab sessions, faculty bio, certification details, and upcoming batch cohorts.

Feature Name: Upcoming Batch Cohort Discovery & Seat Counts
Business Rule: [DOCUMENTED] Lists upcoming batch cohorts for a course. Each batch has batch_code (e.g. 'SPAWN-OCT26'), start_date, end_date, total capacity, and real-time enrolled_count. Calculates remaining seats.

[DOCUMENTED] During masterclass booking, collects trainee full legal name (for certificate issuance), 10-digit phone number, email address, physical mailing address, and prior cultivation experience level.

Feature Name: Batch Seat Reservation with Promo Support
Business Rule: [DOCUMENTED] Reserves a seat in batch cohort. Throws BatchCapacityExceededException if cohort is full. Applies trainee coupon code if provided. Creates enrollment record in PENDING_PAYMENT status and increments enrolled_count.

[DOCUMENTED] Trainees can cancel registration up to 48 hours before batch start_date. Decrements batch enrolled_count. If fee was paid, refunds amount directly to customer's Sporekart Wallet. Sets enrollment status CANCELLED.
[DOCUMENTED] Fetches authenticated trainee's masterclass registrations: course title, batch dates, cohort code, payment status, syllabus link, and certificate access.
[DOCUMENTED] Instructors record daily session attendance for trainees in attendances table. Minimum 80% attendance required for course completion eligibility.

[DOCUMENTED] When course is marked complete, generates unique verifiable certificate number ('SK-CERT-YYYY-XXXXX'). Persists completion and certificate records. Automatically grants commercial training capability on customer profile. Issues PDF certificate.
[DOCUMENTED] Maintains curated public gallery of masterclass classroom photos, lab inoculation sessions, mushroom harvesting workshops, and grower success stories.

[DOCUMENTED] Customers can open support tickets by specifying category (ORDER_ISSUE, PRODUCT_QUALITY, SPAWN_CONTAMINATION, TRAINING_QUERY, PAYMENT_DISPUTE), priority (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, URGENT), subject, and description. Generates unique ticket number ('TICK-XXXXXX').
[DOCUMENTED] Maintains threaded chronological conversation between customer and support agents on an active ticket. Supports customer replies and agent responses.
[DOCUMENTED] Helpdesk agents can view all open tickets, filter by category/priority, update priority, assign staff, reply as official support, and resolve tickets.

Feature Name: Ticket Resolution & Customer CSAT Rating Submission
Business Rule: [DOCUMENTED] When customer or admin closes a ticket, customer is prompted to submit CSAT rating (1 to 5 stars) and optional feedback commentary. Marks ticket CLOSED.
[DOCUMENTED] Computes aggregated customer satisfaction metrics: average CSAT rating, resolution SLA times, open ticket counts, and category breakdown for management review.
[DOCUMENTED] When an order transitions to DELIVERED, unlocks review invitations in review_invitation_states for each delivered order item. Client modal prompts verified buyer to rate items.

[DOCUMENTED] Customers submit rating (1 to 5 stars), review title, detailed commentary, and up to 5 user photos. Sets is_verified_purchase=TRUE. Initial status is PENDING_MODERATION (or auto-published based on config).

Feature Name: Public Product Review & Rating Aggregate Display
Business Rule: [DOCUMENTED] Fetches approved, published reviews for product detail page. Calculates weighted average rating score and 1-5 star distribution breakdown.
[DOCUMENTED] Administrators inspect submitted reviews and images in Admin Console. Can approve (PUBLISHED), reject (REJECTED), or flag for review. Mandatory moderation reason on rejection.
[DOCUMENTED] Verified masterclass trainees can evaluate completed training courses: rate curriculum quality (1-5), practical lab experience, instructor knowledge, and provide testimonials.
[DOCUMENTED] Customer can dismiss or skip review modal ('Maybe Later' or 'Don't ask again'). Updates review_invitation_states status to SKIPPED or DISMISSED to prevent harassing the customer.

[DOCUMENTED] Implements the Transactional Outbox pattern. Domain services (Order, Payment, Training, Support, Wallet) persist notification_events in the same database transaction as the business event. Status initialized to PENDING with attempt_count=0.

[DOCUMENTED] NotificationWorker picks up PENDING email events, renders dynamic HTML templates (order receipt, packing notice, delivery alert, wallet credit), and transmits via JavaMailSender using Gmail SMTP with TLS. Marks event SENT.

[DOCUMENTED] Dispatches critical operational alerts (OTP, Order Confirmed, Shipped with AWB link, Delivered) via Twilio SMS REST API to recipient phone number. Formats Indian E.164 phone numbers (+91).

Feature Name: Scheduled Outbox Worker with Exponential Backoff
Business Rule: [DOCUMENTED] Executes every 10 seconds (@Scheduled(fixedDelay = 10000)). Fetches top 20 pending notifications ordered by created_at. Dispatches and increments attempt_count. Moves to DEAD_LETTER if attempt_count > 5.

[DOCUMENTED] Runs every 15 minutes (@Scheduled(cron = '0 */15 * * * *')). Scans for active carts untouched for > 1 hour. Dispatches reminder email with promo incentive. Uses daily deduplication key 'CART_ABANDONED:{cartId}:{date}'.

Feature Name: Customer In-App Notification Center & Unread Badge
Business Rule: [DOCUMENTED] Provides real-time bell icon in Navbar with unread counter. Displays customer alerts (order packed, shipped, out for delivery, wallet refund, ticket reply). Supports mark-as-read and mark-all-read.
[DOCUMENTED] Operational alerts for admin operators: new high-value orders, payment disputes, out-of-stock warnings, new customer support tickets, withdrawal requests requiring approval.
[DOCUMENTED] Publishes technical mycology articles, pest management guides, climate control advice, and substrate prep guides. Indexed by category and multi-tag associations.

[DOCUMENTED] Renders full article content in Markdown/HTML with featured hero image, table of contents, author bio, social share buttons, related product cards, and structured JSON-LD Article metadata.
[DOCUMENTED] Runs every 5 minutes (@Scheduled(cron = '0 */5 * * * *')). Scans for articles in SCHEDULED status where scheduled_publish_time <= NOW(). Automatically transitions status to PUBLISHED.

[DOCUMENTED] Generates valid XML sitemap conforming to sitemaps.org protocol. Dynamically includes all active products, training masterclasses, published blog posts, agronomy guides, and core static landing pages with lastmod and changefreq.

[DOCUMENTED] Generates compliant robots.txt. Disallows indexing of private operational routes (/admin/, /dashboard/, /api/, /checkout/) while permitting public storefront, blogs, and guides. References sitemap.xml URL.

[DOCUMENTED] Provides structured, step-by-step guides for growers: Mushroom Cultivation Guide (Sterilization, Inoculation, Spawn Run, Pinning, Harvesting) and Spawn Guide (Grain Selection, Autoclaving, Clean Bench Protocols).

[DOCUMENTED] Client requests upload for image (product photo, review attachment, blog image). Validates MIME type (image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp) and file size (max 10MB). Generates presigned S3/Supabase upload URL and creates media_assets row in PENDING_UPLOAD status.

[DOCUMENTED] After direct client upload succeeds, client confirms completion. Backend verifies object presence in bucket, extracts actual file size and dimensions, marks media_assets status AVAILABLE, and generates public CDN URL.

Feature Name: Signed URL Generation for Protected Assets
Business Rule: [DOCUMENTED] For private training course materials, certificates, or confidential invoices, generates time-limited signed viewing URLs (default 15-minute expiration).

Feature Name: Media Linking to Products and Courses
Business Rule: [DOCUMENTED] Maps uploaded media assets to specific entities via join tables media_product_links and media_course_links. Supports display sequence order and primary hero image flag.
[DOCUMENTED] Captures client product view events with product ID, slug, title, user ID (or anonymous session ID), and timestamp. Records event in analytics_events table asynchronously.
[DOCUMENTED] Tracks sequential funnel conversion milestones: PRODUCT_VIEW -> CART_ADD -> CHECKOUT_STARTED -> ORDER_CREATED -> PAYMENT_COMPLETED. Calculates drop-off percentages.

Feature Name: Asynchronous Event Consumption via Spring Events
Business Rule: [DOCUMENTED] Listens for domain events published across modules via Spring ApplicationEventPublisher (OrderCreatedEvent, OrderDeliveredEvent, CourseCompletedEvent). Updates pre-aggregated daily analytics_metrics in isolated transaction.
[DOCUMENTED] Provides executive metrics dashboard for store management: Total Revenue (INR), Gross Margin, Total Orders, Average Order Value (AOV), Active Training Cohorts, and Trainee Headcount.

[DOCUMENTED] Consolidated administrative command center providing tabbed operations for Catalog, Orders, Courier Dispatches, Finance Ledger, Customer Directory, Training Masterclasses, Agronomy Blogs, Support Helpdesk, and Telemetry.

[DOCUMENTED] Every mutating administrative operation (product status toggle, manual stock adjustment, refund approval, order status override, withdrawal payout, customer capability grant) writes an immutable record to admin_audit_logs with operator user ID, action enum, resource ID, IP address, and JSON diff payload.

[DOCUMENTED] Executes on application startup via Spring CommandLineRunner. Checks if an active administrator exists in users table. If none exists, bootstraps default administrator account from environment variables (ADMIN_INITIAL_EMAIL, ADMIN_INITIAL_PHONE).

[DOCUMENTED] Intercepts all incoming HTTP requests before UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter. Extracts 'Bearer <token>' from Authorization header. Validates cryptographic signature, issuer, and expiration. Populates Spring SecurityContextHolder.

[DOCUMENTED] Enforces authorization boundaries via SecurityConfig and @PreAuthorize annotations. Public endpoints (/catalog, /search, /training, /cart) accessible to all. Protected customer endpoints (/customer, /wallet, /support) require ROLE_CUSTOMER. Protected management endpoints (/admin/**) strictly require ROLE_ADMIN.

Feature Name: In-Memory Token Bucket Rate Limiting Filter
Business Rule: [DOCUMENTED] Protects public API endpoints (/auth/otp, /cart, /search) against brute-force and Denial-of-Service attacks. Implements in-memory token bucket algorithm per client IP address. Returns HTTP 429 Too Many Requests when rate limit exceeded.

[DOCUMENTED] RequestIdFilter inspects incoming requests for 'X-Request-ID' header. If absent, generates random UUID. Injects into SLF4J MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) and writes 'X-Request-ID' to response headers. Enables end-to-end distributed trace correlation.

[DOCUMENTED] Centralized @RestControllerAdvice catches all exceptions. Sanitizes internal database error messages, stack traces, and SQL queries to prevent information disclosure. Formats errors into standardized ApiResponse.error(code, message).

[DOCUMENTED] Configures strict Cross-Origin Resource Sharing. In production, allows only explicit whitelisted domains (CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS). Enables allowCredentials=true, exposes X-Request-ID and Authorization headers. In dev, permits localhost origins. Enforces X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN (or DENY) to prevent clickjacking.
